raw_evidence.context: Funding Body Reporting Warwick is proud to work with a number of UK and global organisations and governments which fund academically excellent students to pursue higher education in the UK and we currently have over 150 individuals enrolled through prestigious scholarship schemes. Many funding bodies require the University to provide regular reports detailing academic performance and progress and we are required to report any pastoral and engagement concerns that may impact a student's studies and experience. This reporting enables the funding body to work with the University to provide any additional support that might be required. In order to share this information with sponsors and funding bodies, Warwick requires written consent from scholars agreeing to this. Please complete the form below at the earliest opportunity so that the University can complete its reporting obligations and your funding is not put at risk. raw_evidence.name: Agent Training
raw_evidence.context: Agents shall promote themselves and University of Warwick fairly and without recourse to unfavourable, inaccurate, misleading or negative comparisons with other universities. Nor shall they employ unfair or unprofessional practice to damage the interests of other institutions. Agents must conduct themselves with full consideration of the regulatory conditions in the markets where they operate, ensuring compliance with all relevant national laws, regulations, and official policies. Agents must conduct themselves with full transparency and openness in all their interactions with University of Warwick. Agent Training All agents will be expected to take part in regular training at the point of induction, and in each academic year of the contract validity.
